mechanism_narrative: A strong labor market, indicated by high employment growth (PAYEMS), signals robust consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where PAYEMS is above its 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is at or below 0.1%, the Federal Reserve is in an ultra-accommodative stance, which compresses discount rates and supports equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for FEDFUNDS <= 0.1% is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in such periods are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 270 and the federal funds rate remains below 0.1%, the market anticipates aggressive future monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion phase, indicated by housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 1500 thousand units, the S&P 500 tends to underperform in the next 20 trading days due to expectations of policy tightening and economic slowdown.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where HOUST > 1500, or the regime-specific effect is not significant (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 indicates a contraction in manufacturing and mining, signaling potential recession and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO < 100, or the effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A high unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5.0% reflects economic weakness and reduced consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE > 5.0, or the effect is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Strong retail sales (RSAFS) indicate robust consumer demand and corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where RSAFS is above its 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: An ultra-low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS <= 0.1%) supports prolonged equity valuations, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for FEDFUNDS <= 0.1% is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in such periods are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).
